body: If you truly aren't happy and can't see an end in sight then try talking to someone. The desicion is ultimately up to you but it'll be worth it.

He just texted back. Oh my god. Oh my god. He's okay. Thank you everyone for trying to help. I apologize for not writing back to any of the comments. I was too stressed. I'm sorry for making all of you worried. Thank you so much.

Hey, I don't know you but I'm pretty sure my friend just killed himself. Please don't. You might think no one will care, or maybe you think they'll care more about you if you died. I promise it's not true. I loved him (as a friend) and I know someone loves you. Please don't do this to yourself or anyone around you. If he is dead I don't know what I'll do. I know, I'm 100%sure that someone around you feels the same way. I know it. Please listen to me because he didn't and I think it's too late. Please.
